Game Master Commands

GENERATED by scripts/generate-gm-command-reference (profile basic, 2026-10-09 18:17) from the world database's `command` table, the server's C++ command tables and config/custom-gm-commands.lua. Don't edit by hand: edit those, run it again. Why: one place to find every game master command, and the project's own.

GAME MASTER COMMANDS -- EVERLAND GHOSTSONG, PROFILE BASIC

691 commands: mod-ale 1, mod-playerbots 9, stock 650, this project 31. The 31 this project added are listed first, under WHAT'S NEW, and again in place among their relatives, marked NEW.

NEURON

wow-chat-neuron (../wow-chat-neuron/, the control plane for a running AzerothCore world) reaches the world through three channels; its live channel sends game master commands over the worldserver's SOAP console. Every command listed here should be able to become a neuron operation: one declaration, from which neuron draws a command-line subcommand, a tool definition a model can call (a tool call), and an entry in its catalogue (docs/vocabulary.txt there). Each line below already holds what a declaration needs: the command's words (its name), its syntax (its typed parameters), its level (who may pull the lever) and where it runs.

Where it runs decides the channel. A command marked "anywhere" can be sent over SOAP as it stands, so it maps straight onto neuron's live channel. One marked "in game" needs a character in the world (it reads the game master's position, target or selection), so as a neuron operation it would be carried by the resident channel (a Lua script in the server that acts for a named character) or rewritten to take that character as a parameter. A "?" means the code did not say.

HOW TO READ THIS

Systems are in capitals, underlined. Inside a system, command families (a command's first word) are in word order, and inside a family the commands nest by their words: ".account set gmlevel" sits in "account set", inside "account". Each command line gives its syntax, then in brackets who may run it and where:

  player     any account          moderator  game master level 1
  gm         game master level 2  admin      game master level 3
  console    the server console only
  anywhere   runs in game and from the server console (and so over SOAP)
  in game    needs a character in the world
  NEW        added by this project

In a syntax, $word and #number are the stock help's own marks for a value to type; the project's commands use <needed> and [optional], with a|b for a choice. The help under each command is the server's own (.help shows the same), except for NEW ones, whose help is config/custom-gm-commands.lua.

WHAT'S NEW: THE COMMANDS THIS PROJECT ADDED

ITEMS AND MAIL

elite

.elite <partner> gmanywherenew

Short for ".gearset elite buddies <partner>": every buddy of that player in the elite gearset.

gearset

.gearset <profile> <character> | <profile> buddies <partner> gmanywherenew

Dresses a character, or every buddy of a player in the world (the "buddies" form), in a gearset profile (src/lua-basic/data/gearsets/<profile>.lua), by spec or class and race: each slot's item is replaced, proficiencies it needs are taught, bags go into empty bag slots, ammunition is added. Shirt and tabard are never touched. Anyone with no record in the profile is named and left as they are.

CREATURES AND WORLD OBJECTS

basic

basic worldboss

.basic worldboss respawn <spawn number> gmanywherenew

Brings a world boss back now, by its spawn number. The world bosses' Lua countdown calls this when a boss is due.

.basic worldboss status gmanywherenew

Lists every world boss spawn, its creature and whether it is alive or dead, and whether the world boss battle bonus is on.

GROUPS, GUILDS AND PVP

arena

.arena start gmin gamenew

A monster ring for watching buddies fight: stand in the Gurubashi Arena ring and three groups of three monsters near your level appear at the places farthest from your party; each one that dies is replaced at a far place.

.arena stop gmin gamenew

Ends the arena trial and removes its monsters.

COMPANIONS

buddies

.buddies revive [name] at <me|partner|graveyard> [ring|centre] gmanywherenew

Brings every dead buddy of a player back to life at you, at the player, or at the graveyard nearest the player that their side may use.

buddies to

.buddies to me [name] [ring|centre] gmin gamenew

Brings every one of a player's buddies in the world to you, the game master, placed round you as above.

.buddies to partner [name] [ring|centre] gmanywherenew

Brings every one of a player's buddies in the world to that player. No name: your selected target, the player or one of their buddies. They are placed on a ring or an arc round the player (a ring three times in four unless asked).

buddy

buddy bed

.buddy bed add <bed|cot|floor> [note] gmin gamenew

Marks the spot you stand on, facing the way you face, as a place buddies sleep, at that comfort (bed 3, cot 2, floor 1). The note is kept with it.

.buddy bed link gmin gamenew

Joins the nearest sleeping spot to the next nearest, as one shared bed; both must be within 5 yards. A third spot is joined by standing between it and one of the pair.

.buddy bed list gmin gamenew

Lists the sleeping spots of the area you stand in, nearest first.

.buddy bed remove gmin gamenew

Removes the nearest sleeping spot within 10 yards.

.buddy bed unlink gmin gamenew

The nearest sleeping spot within 5 yards stands alone again.

.buddy explore <pinwheel|paint|rooms|disc|mixed> playerin gamenew

Chooses how your own buddies explore a town (the work is in buddies_explore.cpp): the pinwheel, least paint, the room orbit, the squished circle, or each buddy a different one in turn (mixed). Any player may set it for their own buddies.

.buddy kit <buddy name> gmanywherenew

Gives a buddy in the world the kit's gear for its level now, by its talent shape. What it wore is replaced.

.buddy look <skin|face|hair|haircolor|beard> <number> gmanywherenew

Changes one part of Sargobras's look until the server restarts. The client asks for a creature's look when it first sees it: walk out of sight and back, or log out and in, to see the change.

buddy record

.buddy record delete <number> gmin gamenew

Deletes one recording by the number the list shows.

.buddy record discard gmin gamenew

Throws away the recording in progress.

.buddy record list gmin gamenew

Lists the recordings of every ship stop near you, with their numbers.

.buddy record start gmin gamenew

Starts recording your movements at a boat or zeppelin stop, for buddies to replay when they board or leave a ship.

.buddy record stop [note] gmin gamenew

Ends the recording, checks it is one boarding or one leaving at one stop of one ship's route, and keeps it with the note.

buddy standin

.buddy standin at <alliance|horde> <tank|healer|damage> <level> <map> <x> <y> <z> [race] [class] gmanywherenew

Brings a stand-in in at a place, as standin make does beside you. Scenes ask for theirs this way.

.buddy standin dismiss <name|all> gmanywherenew

Takes a stand-in (or every one) out of the world. It is kept for the next asker.

.buddy standin list gmanywherenew

Lists every kept stand-in: race, class, role, talent tree, level, times used, and whether it is in the world.

.buddy standin make <alliance|horde> <tank|healer|damage> <level> [race] [class] gmin gamenew

Brings a stand-in in beside you: a character that belongs to nobody, of that side and role at that level, race and class drawn at random unless named. A kept one that fits is used first (raised to the level if below it); otherwise a new one is made, all its talents in one tree that takes its role.

buddy town

.buddy town here <radius> gmin gamenew

Places a town circle of that radius, in yards, where you stand: inside it buddies behave as in town. It is written to the world database at once.

.buddy town remove gmin gamenew

Removes the nearest town circle that was placed by hand.

.buddy town show gmin gamenew

Draws the nearest town circle in wisps standing on its edge, for 15 seconds.

.buddy trace <buddy name|off> gmanywherenew

Starts writing a log of what that buddy decides and does (it must be online). "off" stops every trace. The reply says where the lines go.

SERVER AND MESSAGES

basic

basic reload

.basic reload multipliers adminanywherenew

Reads the per-creature damage, healing and health multipliers again without a restart. Health changes apply to creatures as they next spawn.

EVERY COMMAND, BY SYSTEM

ACCOUNTS AND ACCESS

account (16 commands)

.account playerin game

Display the access level of your account and the email adress if you possess the necessary permissions.

account 2fa

.account 2fa remove <token> playerin game

Disables two-factor authentication for this account, if enabled.

.account 2fa setup playerin game

Sets up two-factor authentication for this account.

.account addon #addon moderatorin game

Set expansion addon level allowed. Addon values: 0 - normal, 1 - tbc, 2 - wotlk.

.account create $account $password $email consoleanywhere

Create account and set password to it. $email is optional, can be left blank.

.account delete $account consoleanywhere

Delete account with all characters.

account lock

.account lock country [on|off] playeranywhere

Allow login from account only from current used Country or remove this requirement.

.account lock ip [on|off] playeranywhere

Allow login from account only from current used IP or remove this requirement.

.account onlinelist consoleanywhere

Show list of online accounts.

.account password $old_password $new_password $new_password [$email] playerin game

Change your account password. You may need to check the actual security mode to see if email input is necessary.

account remove

.account remove country <account> adminanywhere

Removes the country information associated with the specified account.

account set

Type .account set to see the list of possible subcommands or .help account set $subcommand to see info on subcommands

.account set 2fa <account> <secret/off> playeranywhere

Provide a base32 encoded secret to setup two-factor authentication for the account. Specify 'off' to disable two-factor authentication for the account.

.account set addon [$account] #addon gmanywhere

Set user (possible targeted) expansion addon level allowed. Addon values: 0 - normal, 1 - tbc, 2 - wotlk.

.account set email $account $email $email_confirmation adminanywhere

Add or change an email to the account.

.account set gmlevel [$account] #level [#realmid] adminanywhere

Set the security level for targeted player (can't be used at self) or for account $name to a level of #level on the realm #realmID. #level may range from 0 to 3. #reamID may be -1 for all realms.

.account set password $account $password $password adminanywhere

Set password for account.

kick (1 command)

.kick [$charactername] [$reason] gmanywhere

Kick the given character name from the world with or without reason. If no character name is provided then the selected player (except for yourself) will be kicked. If no reason is provided, default is "No Reason".

mute (1 command)

.mute [$playerName] $mutetime [$reason] gmanywhere

Disible chat messaging for any character from account of character $playerName (or currently selected) at $mutetime time. Player can be offline. $mutetime: use a timestring like "1d15h33s".

mutehistory (1 command)

.mutehistory $accountName. Shows mute history for an account. gmanywhere

ticket (19 commands)

Type .ticket to see the list of possible subcommands or .help ticket $subcommand to see info on subcommands

.ticket assign gmanywhere

Usage: .ticket assign $ticketid $gmname. Assigns the specified ticket to the specified Game Master.

.ticket close gmanywhere

Usage: .ticket close $ticketid. Closes the specified ticket. Does not delete permanently.

.ticket closedlist gmanywhere

Displays a list of closed GM tickets.

.ticket comment gmanywhere

.ticket reset consoleanywhere

.ticket response append gmanywhere

.ticket response appendln gmanywhere

Add a response to a new line. Syntax: ticket response appendln $ticketId $response

.ticket response delete gmanywhere

Delete a ticket response Syntax: ticket response delete $ticketId

.ticket response show gmanywhere

Show a ticket response Syntax: ticket response show $ticketId

.ticket togglesystem adminanywhere

Toggle whether tickets are allowed or disallowed.

.ticket unassign gmanywhere

Usage: .ticket unassign $ticketid. Unassigns the specified ticket from the current assigned Game Master.

.ticket viewid gmanywhere

Usage: .ticket viewid $ticketid. Returns details about specified ticket. Ticket must be open and not deleted.

.ticket viewname gmanywhere

Usage: .ticket viewname $creatorname. Returns details about specified ticket. Ticket must be open and not deleted.

GAME MASTER TOOLS

aura (2 commands)

.aura #spellid gmin game

Add the aura from spell #spellid to the selected Unit.

.aurastack #spellid #stacks gmin game

Modify #stacks of an already applied #spellid to the selected Unit.

bindsight (1 command)

.bindsight adminin game

Binds vision to the selected unit indefinitely. Cannot be used while currently possessing a target.

cast (6 commands)

.cast #spellid [triggered] gmin game

Cast #spellid to selected target. If no target selected cast to self. If 'triggered' or part provided then spell cast with triggered flag.

.cast back #spellid [triggered] gmin game

Selected target will cast #spellid to your character. If 'triggered' or part provided then spell cast with triggered flag.

.cast dest #spellid #x #y #z [triggered] gmin game

Selected target will cast #spellid at provided destination. If 'triggered' or part provided then spell cast with triggered flag.

.cast dist #spellid [#dist [triggered]] gmin game

You will cast spell to point at distance #dist. If 'triggered' or part provided then spell cast with triggered flag. Not all spells can be cast as area spells.

.cast self #spellid [triggered] gmin game

Cast #spellid by target at target itself. If 'triggered' or part provided then spell cast with triggered flag.

.cast target #spellid [triggered] gmin game

Selected target will cast #spellid to his victim. If 'triggered' or part provided then spell cast with triggered flag.

chatfilter (3 commands)

Type .chatfilter to see a list of subcommands or .help chatfilter $subcommand to see info on subcommands.

.chatfilter add $word adminanywhere

Add $word to the `chat_filter` table and reload the chat filter.

.chatfilter list gmanywhere

List all entries from the `chat_filter` table.

.chatfilter remove $word adminanywhere

Remove $word from the `chat_filter` table and reload the chat filter.

cheat (8 commands)

Type .cheat to see the list of possible subcommands or .help cheat $subcommand to see info on subcommands

.cheat casttime [on/off] gmin game

Remove spells' casting time.

.cheat cooldown [on/off] gmin game

Disable spells' cooldowns.

.cheat explore #flag gmin game

Reveal or hide all maps for the selected player. If no player is selected, hide or reveal maps to you. Use a #flag of value 1 to reveal, use a #flag value of 0 to hide all maps.

.cheat god [on/off] gmin game

Turn the user invulnerable.

.cheat power [on/off] gmin game

Remove spells' cost (mana, energy, rage...).

.cheat status gmin game

Shows the cheats you currently have enabled.

.cheat taxi on/off gmin game

Temporary grant access to all taxi routes for the selected character. If no character is selected, hide or reveal all routes to you. Visited taxi nodes are still accessible after removing access.

.cheat waterwalk on/off gmin game

Allow to walk on water (self or selected character).

combatstop (1 command)

.combatstop [$playername] gmanywhere

Stop combat for selected character. If selected non-player then command applied to self. If $playername provided then attempt applied to online player $playername.

cometome (1 command)

.cometome $parameter adminin game

Make selected creature come to your current location (new position not saved to DB).

commands (1 command)

.commands playeranywhere

Display a list of available commands for your account level.

cooldown (1 command)

.cooldown [#spell_id] gmin game

Remove all (if spell_id not provided) or #spel_id spell cooldown from selected character or you (if no selection).

damage (1 command)

.damage $damage_amount [$school [$spellid]] gmin game

Apply $damage to target. If not $school and $spellid provided then this flat clean melee damage without any modifiers. If $school provided then damage modified by armor reduction (if school physical), and target absorbing modifiers and result applied as melee damage to target. If spell provided then damage modified and applied as spell damage. $spellid can be shift-link.

dev (1 command)

.dev [on/off] adminin game

Enable or Disable in game Dev tag or show current state if on/off not provided.

die (1 command)

.die gmin game

Kill the selected player. If no player is selected, it will kill you.

freeze (1 command)

.freeze (#player) gmin game

"Freezes" #player and disables his chat. When using this without #name it will freeze your target.

gm (8 commands)

Enable or Disable in game GM MODE or show current state of on/off not provided.

.gm chat [on/off] gmin game

Enable or disable chat GM MODE (show gm badge in messages) or show current state of on/off not provided.

.gm fly [on/off] gmin game

Enable/disable gm fly mode.

.gm ingame playeranywhere

Display a list of available in game Game Masters.

.gm list adminanywhere

Turns off GM flag.

.gm on moderatorin game

Turns on GM flag.

.gm spectator on|off gmin game

Requires .gm on. Allows the GM character to follow members of the opposite faction. You may need to change zones for the effect to apply.

.gm visible on/off gmin game

Output current visibility state or make GM visible(on) and invisible(off) for other players.

possess (1 command)

.possess gmin game

revive (1 command)

.revive gmanywhere

Revive the selected player. If no player is selected, it will revive you.

unbindsight (1 command)

unfreeze (1 command)

.unfreeze (#player) gmin game

"Unfreezes" #player and enables his chat again. When using this without #name it will unfreeze your target.

unpossess (1 command)

.unpossess gmin game

If you are possessed, unpossesses yourself; otherwise unpossesses current possessed target.

whispers (1 command)

.whispers on|off moderatorin game

Enable/disable accepting whispers by GM from players. By default use trinityd.conf setting.

cache (3 commands)

Character data cached during start up. Type .cache to see a list of subcommands or .help $subcommand to see info on subcommands.

.cache delete $playerName adminanywhere

Deletes the cached data for the selected character. Use for debugging only!

.cache info $playerName gmanywhere

Displays cached data for the selected character.

.cache refresh $playerName gmanywhere

Deletes the current cache and refreshes it with updated data.

character (16 commands)

Type .character to see a list of possible subcommands or .help character $subcommand to see info on the subcommand.

.character changeaccount $NewAccountName $Name. adminanywhere

Moves the specified character to the provided account. Kicks the player if the character is online.

.character changefaction $name gmanywhere

Change character faction.

.character changerace $name gmanywhere

Change character race.

character check

.character check bag [$target_player] #bagSlot 1 - 4 gmanywhere
.character check bank gmanywhere

Show your bank inventory.

.character check profession [$target_player] gmanywhere

Show known professions list for selected player

.character customize [$name] gmanywhere

Mark selected in game or by $name in command character for customize at next login.

character deleted

.character deleted delete #guid|$name consoleanywhere

Completely deletes the selected characters. If $name is supplied, only characters with that string in their name will be deleted, if #guid is supplied, only the character with that GUID will be deleted.

.character deleted list [#guid|$name] adminanywhere

Shows a list with all deleted characters. If $name is supplied, only characters with that string in their name will be selected, if #guid is supplied, only the character with that GUID will be selected.

.character deleted purge [#keepDays] consoleanywhere

Completely removes all characters from the database that where deleted more than #keepDays ago. If #keepDays not provided the used value from worldserver.conf option 'CharDelete.KeepDays'. If 'CharDelete.KeepDays' option is disabled (set to value 0) then this command can't be used without the specifying #keepDays parameter.

.character deleted restore #guid|$name [$newname] [#new account] adminanywhere

Restores deleted characters. If $name is supplied, only characters with that string in their name will be restored, if $guid is supplied, only the character with that GUID will be restored. If $newname is set, the character will be restored with that name instead of the original one. If #newaccount is set, the character will be restored to specific account character list. This works only with one character!

.character erase $name consoleanywhere

Delete character $name. Character finally deleted in case any deleting options.

.character level [$playername] [#level] gmanywhere

Set the level of character with $playername (or the selected if not name provided) by #numberoflevels Or +1 if no #numberoflevels provided). If #numberoflevels is omitted, the level will be increase by 1. If #numberoflevels is 0, the same level will be restarted. If no character is selected and name not provided, increase your level. Command can be used for offline character. All stats and dependent values recalculated. At level decrease talents can be reset if need. Also at level decrease equipped items with greater level requirement can be lost.

.character rename [$name] [reserveName] [$newName] gmanywhere

Builds a ladder by combining team brackets and provides rewards from the arena_season_reward table. Example usage: # Combine all brackets, build a ladder, and distribute rewards among them .arena season reward all # Build ladders separately for 2v2, 3v3, and 5v5 brackets so each bracket receives its own rewards .arena season reward 2 .arena season reward 3 .arena season reward 5 # Combine 2v2 and 3v3 brackets and distribute rewards .arena season reward 2,3

Ends the arena trial and removes its monsters.

COMPANIONS

buddies (3 commands, 3 new)

.buddies revive [name] at <me|partner|graveyard> [ring|centre] gmanywherenew

Brings every dead buddy of a player back to life at you, at the player, or at the graveyard nearest the player that their side may use.

buddies to

.buddies to me [name] [ring|centre] gmin gamenew

Brings every one of a player's buddies in the world to you, the game master, placed round you as above.

.buddies to partner [name] [ring|centre] gmanywherenew

Brings every one of a player's buddies in the world to that player. No name: your selected target, the player or one of their buddies. They are placed on a ring or an arc round the player (a ring three times in four unless asked).

buddy (21 commands, 21 new)

buddy bed

.buddy bed add <bed|cot|floor> [note] gmin gamenew

Marks the spot you stand on, facing the way you face, as a place buddies sleep, at that comfort (bed 3, cot 2, floor 1). The note is kept with it.

.buddy bed link gmin gamenew

Joins the nearest sleeping spot to the next nearest, as one shared bed; both must be within 5 yards. A third spot is joined by standing between it and one of the pair.

.buddy bed list gmin gamenew

Lists the sleeping spots of the area you stand in, nearest first.

.buddy bed remove gmin gamenew

Removes the nearest sleeping spot within 10 yards.

.buddy bed unlink gmin gamenew

The nearest sleeping spot within 5 yards stands alone again.

.buddy explore <pinwheel|paint|rooms|disc|mixed> playerin gamenew

Chooses how your own buddies explore a town (the work is in buddies_explore.cpp): the pinwheel, least paint, the room orbit, the squished circle, or each buddy a different one in turn (mixed). Any player may set it for their own buddies.

.buddy kit <buddy name> gmanywherenew

Gives a buddy in the world the kit's gear for its level now, by its talent shape. What it wore is replaced.

.buddy look <skin|face|hair|haircolor|beard> <number> gmanywherenew

Changes one part of Sargobras's look until the server restarts. The client asks for a creature's look when it first sees it: walk out of sight and back, or log out and in, to see the change.

buddy record

.buddy record delete <number> gmin gamenew

Deletes one recording by the number the list shows.

.buddy record discard gmin gamenew

Throws away the recording in progress.

.buddy record list gmin gamenew

Lists the recordings of every ship stop near you, with their numbers.

.buddy record start gmin gamenew

Starts recording your movements at a boat or zeppelin stop, for buddies to replay when they board or leave a ship.

.buddy record stop [note] gmin gamenew

Ends the recording, checks it is one boarding or one leaving at one stop of one ship's route, and keeps it with the note.

buddy standin

.buddy standin at <alliance|horde> <tank|healer|damage> <level> <map> <x> <y> <z> [race] [class] gmanywherenew

Brings a stand-in in at a place, as standin make does beside you. Scenes ask for theirs this way.

.buddy standin dismiss <name|all> gmanywherenew

Takes a stand-in (or every one) out of the world. It is kept for the next asker.

.buddy standin list gmanywherenew

Lists every kept stand-in: race, class, role, talent tree, level, times used, and whether it is in the world.

.buddy standin make <alliance|horde> <tank|healer|damage> <level> [race] [class] gmin gamenew

Brings a stand-in in beside you: a character that belongs to nobody, of that side and role at that level, race and class drawn at random unless named. A kept one that fits is used first (raised to the level if below it); otherwise a new one is made, all its talents in one tree that takes its role.

buddy town

.buddy town here <radius> gmin gamenew

Places a town circle of that radius, in yards, where you stand: inside it buddies behave as in town. It is written to the world database at once.

.buddy town remove gmin gamenew

Removes the nearest town circle that was placed by hand.

.buddy town show gmin gamenew

Draws the nearest town circle in wisps standing on its edge, for 15 seconds.

.buddy trace <buddy name|off> gmanywherenew

Starts writing a log of what that buddy decides and does (it must be online). "off" stops every trace. The reply says where the lines go.

Type .list to see the list of possible subcommands or .help list $subcommand to see info on subcommands

list auras

.list auras moderatorin game

List auras (passive and active) of selected creature or player. If no creature or player is selected, list your own auras.

.list auras id moderatorin game

Lists all active auras on the selected unit by spell ID.

.list auras name moderatorin game

Lists all active auras on the selected unit by spell name.

.list creature #creature_id [#max_count] moderatoranywhere

Output creatures with creature id #creature_id found in world. Output creature guids and coordinates sorted by distance from character. Will be output maximum #max_count creatures. If #max_count not provided use 10 as default value.

.list item #item_id [#max_count] moderatoranywhere

Output items with item id #item_id found in all character inventories, mails, auctions, and guild banks. Output item guids, item owner guid, owner account and owner name (guild name and guid in case guild bank). Will be output maximum #max_count items. If #max_count not provided use 10 as default value.

server (16 commands)

Type .server to see the list of possible subcommands or .help server $subcommand to see info on subcommands

.server corpses gmanywhere

Triggering corpses expire check in world.

.server debug adminanywhere

Shows detailed information about the server setup, useful when reporting a bug.

.server exit consoleanywhere

Terminate AzerothCore NOW. Exit code 0.

server idlerestart

.server idlerestart #delay consoleanywhere

Restart the server after #delay if no active connections are present (no players). Use #exist_code or 2 as program exist code. #delay: use a timestring like "1h15m30s".

.server idlerestart cancel adminanywhere

Cancel the restart/shutdown timer if any.

server idleshutdown

.server idleshutdown #delay [#exist_code] consoleanywhere

Shut the server down after #delay if no active connections are present (no players). Use #exist_code or 0 as program exist code. #delay: use a timestring like "1h15m30s".

.server idleshutdown cancel adminanywhere

Cancel the restart/shutdown timer if any.

.server info playeranywhere

Display server version and the number of connected players.

.server motd playeranywhere

Show server Message of the day.

server restart

.server restart #delay adminanywhere

Restart the server after #delay. Use #exist_code or 2 as program exist code. #delay: use a timestring like "1h15m30s".

.server restart cancel adminanywhere

Cancel the restart/shutdown timer if any.

server set

.server set closed on/off consoleanywhere

Sets whether the world accepts new client connectsions.

.server set loglevel $facility $name $loglevel. $facility can take the values: appender (a) or logger (l). $loglevel can take the values: disabled (0), consoleanywhere

trace (1), debug (2), info (3), warn (4), error (5) or fatal (6)

.server set motd Optional($realmId) Optional($locale) $MOTD Set server Message of the day for the specified $realmId. If $realmId is not provided it will update for the current realm. Use $realmId -1 to set motd for all realms. If $locale is not provided enUS will be used. adminanywhere

server shutdown

.server shutdown #delay [#exit_code] adminanywhere

Shut the server down after #delay. Use #exit_code or 0 as program exit code. #delay: use a timestring like "1h15m30s".

.server shutdown cancel adminanywhere

Cancel the restart/shutdown timer if any.
